prompt: Pick your main project. In two minutes, tell me what problem it solves, who uses it, what you personally built, and how the main parts fit together.
hint: Cover four things in order: the problem and user, your own role, the main components, and how data flows between them.

recognize.text: States the problem the project solves and who it is for
States their own role, not just the team's

hint.text: States the problem the project solves and who it is for

apply.text: Names the main components (for example frontend, backend, database) and what each does
Describes how data or requests flow between the components

explain.text: Justifies at least one technology or design choice with a reason
Names an alternative that was considered

transfer.text: Adapts the design to the new requirement and names what must change

variant.prompt: Twist: the project must now handle 100 times more users. What would you change first, and why?

followUp: Why did you choose that technology or design over the alternatives?
